title: Westcott Theater’s permitting troubles continue: Syracuse police shut down another event
summary: The Westcott Theater experienced another police shutdown of an event on August 22, 2026, due to missing required permits, with the venue manager cited. This recurring permitting failure suggests systemic issues with the Department of Permits and Development's oversight or the venue's compliance processes that warrant investigation.
